messages:
amanda_sales: Lighthouse Health closed today  handing to CS. Key asks: on-prem package behind customer firewall (air-gapped option possible), BAA + SOC2 proof, disk encryption with customer KMS, SAML SSO (Azure AD), client wants deterministic throughput for 50 qps sustained, ingest ~500GB/day. Go-live target 2026-06-01 but can slide if infra takes longer. Sales opened RED-4001 (provisioning) and attached commercial terms. Please assign owners and list immediate blockers. Link: https://redwood.app/contracts/LH-2026

omar_cs: Thanks Amanda. I'll own the CS program. Immediate owners I propose: infra validation & deploy plan -> @talia_support; capacity sizing & perf -> @nate_eng; compliance/BAA -> @ravi_compliance; enablement & evaluation -> @zoe_enable. I'll create CS-PL-1107 to track. Goal: SSO + connectivity + sample eval run in 10 business days.

talia_support: On infra: need clarification on "on-prem package" details. Is customer asking for our on-prem bundle that we ship as an appliance, or do they want VPC peering to our private control plane with strict IP allowlist? Sales notes were ambiguous. If true on-prem, we'll start export packaging and packaging checklist; ETA for initial install artifact: 7 business days. Deliverables: network diagram, install runbook, cert exchange POA, and firewall rules.

amanda_sales: They explicitly requested an on-prem appliance for PHI reasons, but said they'd consider VPC-peering if we can support air-gapped cert rotation and HSM-backed keys. I'll confirm this afternoon and post update to RED-4001.

nate_eng: Capacity note: 50 qps sustained + 500GB/day ingestion for embeddings/search should be fine on a small Dedicated pool if models are standard. For on-prem appliance we need to check local GPU inventory (customer said "two A100-class nodes"). I'll need a matrix of expected sequence lengths and tokenization for documents. I'll open ENG-9101 to validate memory footprint and perf. ETA for initial perf sketch: 2 business days.

ravi_compliance: I'll start the BAA review. Need customer legal contact and any additional compliance questionnaires (e.g., HITRUST). I'll draft the BAA and route to Legal. Also will ask Security for architecture review once infra diagram is available. ETA for draft: EOD Friday.

zoe_enable: I'll prepare an enablement plan: one onboarding playbook, 2 enablement sessions (admin + dev), and a POC evaluation checklist (PHI redaction, moderation, hallucination thresholds). Need 2 test users and a small (<=100MB) de-identified sample corpus. Will schedule a 45m kickoff after SSO validated.

omar_cs: Action items summary:
 - Confirm on-prem vs VPC-peering (Owner: amanda_sales)
 - Provide customer legal & infra contacts (Owner: amanda_sales)
 - Deliver anonymized sample dataset + sample API schema (Owner: amanda_sales)
 - Infra runbook & firewall rules (Owner: talia_support)
 - Perf triage ENG-9101 (Owner: nate_eng)
 - BAA draft & security review (Owner: ravi_compliance)
 - Enablement sessions & eval checklist (Owner: zoe_enable)
Target: have infra + SSO + first eval run within 10 business days. Please react with :thumbsup: if agree or call out conflicts.

talia_support: Quick questions: 1) If on-prem, do we need to support offline model updates (air-gapped)? 2) Do they require granular audit logs shipped to their SIEM? Both change scope.

amanda_sales: I'll confirm both. They mentioned audit log export to their Splunk instance and periodic offline updates. I'll push for exact requirements and share contact: infra_ops@lighthousehealth.org.

nate_eng: Also: what models are in scope for the POC? If they want large L2 reranking + embeddings we need to validate GPU mem. Ask for representative documents (doc length distribution).

omar_cs: I'll draft a short kickoff agenda and populate CS-PL-1107. Tentative kickoff Tue 11am PT. Zoe will run enablement after SSO. Final note: tracking ticket: https://redwood.app/ops/CS-PL-1107  please centralize artifacts there. Follow-up updates in-thread or on ticket. :white_check_mark:
